g.text: Crafty — local STEP handoff and model publication
Existing local STEP + source may enter here.
A worker path is not automatically an agent path.
Folder contents do not automatically become chat assets.
Derive GLB and fixed-camera PNG from that geometry.
No generated Python runs in the verifier.
A new design gets a new revision; old files stay intact.
Build jobs, publication jobs, ACP turns, and revisions have independent states.
Retrying unchanged input uses a new attempt ID and the same operation identity.
Older completion cannot silently replace a newer selected revision.
Local path is a transfer input; assetId / revisionId is the durable identity.
